description: This file defines a PHP class 'WorkShiftMenuConfigurator' which implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It configures a menu item for the 'workShift' screen within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, utilizing traits and classes related to menu configuration and screen management.

classes.name: WorkShiftMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring menu options related to the Work Shift feature in the HRM system, specifically overriding screen settings for the 'workShift' interface.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the configure method to set the current module and screen to 'workShift' and returns null.
